policy: Fresh child per input, phases within child intentionally retain prior outputs until held sample. Single sample, no repeated statistics. Worker tests use separate child per mode. No formal validation is skipped in product; JSON-only prototypes start from existing verified text.
limitations: Before/after heap is observed occupancy, not exact synchronous peak. maxRSS is OS process high-water mark, includes Node runtime and worker threads, not Chromium JS heap or iPhone RAM.
B lazy string construction alone omits rope flattening; separate SHA phase forces contents and includes two hashes, so is not a direct storage latency comparison.
C yields only between indivisible synchronous phases; no within-parse/stringify improvement.
Worker sends back hash/count receipt, not restored state: round-trip full object reception remains unmeasured.
Worker timers measure this short synthetic Node workload; not browser frame time or Safari performance.
